source.title: Table 6. Schedule C — EPA through Totals + FFB

unit_note: USD millions. Pages 26-27, Table 6 Schedule C: EPA through Total Borrowing from the US Treasury, then Borrowing from the Federal Financing Bank. Two lines are all blank and left out: the HHS Health Maintenance Organization Loan and Loan Guarantee Fund (dots and (**)) and the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation line above the Receiver line (all dots). September's Military Debt Reduction and FCC Spectrum Auction Loan Fund lines do not print. Page 27 repeats the header 'Borrowing from the US Treasury: - Continued' over Federal Financing Bank lines. 34 sums (25 exact, 9 within 1; rounding note on p27): 28 roll-forwards and all six Federal Financing Bank column totals. Total Borrowing from the US Treasury has no column sum here because its lines span five unit files; they foot to it within 3 in every column.
